name: 速读数显探针温度计款
description: 暗调烧烤氛围配白底演示双轨：极速精准读数，防水耐用，全场景通用

styleLock.direction: dark charcoal BBQ atmosphere alternating with clean white info tiles; red body and cyan LCD are the only hero colors
styleLock.temperature: dark scenes 2800-3500K warm firelight; white scenes 5200K neutral soft
styleLock.backgroundSystem: dual track: deep brown-black ember gradients #1A0E08 to #3A1E0E with floating spark particles for emotional shots; seamless white #FFFFFF or white marble #E8E6E2 for demos and guides; white subway tile #F2F0EC for waterproof scenes
styleLock.lightingSystem: warm side-backlight with rim highlights and spark particles on dark shots; soft top light with light contact shadows on white shots; LCD always glows cyan
styleLock.surfaceSystem: seamless white paper, white marble, brushed steel (grill side panel, fridge, feature plates), walnut cutting board #A97944, cast-iron grates #26282A
styleLock.typography: bold uppercase sans-serif headlines with one red accent word, brushed-steel feature plates for spec claims, white chips with red-ring line icons
styleLock.iconSystem: white round chips with red-stroke line icons; steel spec plates; 2x2 grids separated by thin white lines
styleLock.presentationRules: red body never shifts hue; LCD always reads like 149.3F; dark frames always carry spark particles; dark and white tracks alternate for rhythm; gift boxes always with a red ribbon bow
noDrift: waterproof rating and endorsements only from verified facts
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: dark charcoal BBQ atmosphere is the emotional spine of this suite - deep brown-black ember backgrounds #1A0E08 to #3A1E0E with floating orange sparks #E07820, always anchored by the glossy red thermometer body #D8201A and its glowing cyan LCD #3ED8E8 as the only two hero colors. Dark scenes alternate with clean white #FFFFFF or white-marble #E8E6E2 info tiles for demos and guides; waterproof scenes use white subway tile #F2F0EC and brushed steel #8A8D8F. Lighting: warm 2800-3500K side-backlight with rim highlights and spark particles on dark shots, soft top light with light contact shadows on white shots, the LCD always glowing cyan. Bold uppercase sans headlines with one red accent word, red-ring line icons on white chips, brushed-steel plates for spec claims, 2x2 grids divided by thin white lines. The red body never shifts hue, waterproof ratings and endorsements appear only when verified, and no third-party logos or sibling-brand tools may enter the frame.

shots.intent: 首图立信任：主机加礼盒加速查卡全家福，一眼看清买什么送什么
shots.camera: straight-on with a 10-degree downward tilt, body laid diagonally at about 45 degrees with probe extended, gift box below, manual and guide card offset
shots.lighting: high key light from upper left with right-side fill, crisp highlights on the shell
shots.props: black-red gift box, folded manual, temperature guide card
shots.promptTemplate: {style_lock}. Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. Straight-on with a 10-degree downward tilt: the thermometer body laid diagonally at about 45 degrees with its fold-out probe extended and LCD lit cyan #3ED8E8 reading a generic temperature, the black-red gift box below, folded manual and guide card offset around. High-key light from upper left with right fill, crisp shell highlights, soft contact shadows. Seamless white #FFFFFF. Product group occupies 55%. No overlaid text. 2K commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no brand logos or readable pack claims, no hands, no watermark, no extra props, no bent probe, no cut-off edges.

provenance.notes: 源自 9 万+ 评级的探针温度计 A+ 集；剥离品牌标与火焰 logo、媒体推荐墙（第三方商标）、IP67 等级数字（转占位）、季节限定文案、异型号笔式温度计与烤具套装等其他工具；LCD 读数统一为通用样式
